【原视频简介】
Build an AI competitor research agent that finds important product updates and emails you a useful digest every week.

In this tutorial, I build the agent through conversation in Agenta. It researches our market, identifies competitors, adds web search, schedules a weekly run, connects Gmail, and sends the finished report. I also show how to inspect and edit the agent’s instructions instead of treating the automation like a black box.

You will learn how to:

- Create a specialized AI agent from a plain-language request.
- Give it web-search access.
- Schedule it to run every Monday.
- Inspect and edit its instructions, tools, and schedule.
- Connect Gmail and deliver the report automatically.
- Test the automation without waiting for its scheduled run.

Try Agenta: https://agenta.ai
GitHub: https://github.com/Agenta-AI/agenta

What recurring research should I automate next? Tell me in the comments.
